title: Account opening workflow and customer binding
workflow: Create an idempotent account application with selected product
Validate CIF/KYB, required evidence and risk restrictions
Check license, country, customer and product eligibility
Obtain agreement and mandate approvals including dual control as needed
Allocate unique account ID only after approval
Publish AccountOpened event without posting initial monetary balance
invariants: Opening account does not create money or imply a deposit transaction
No KYC clearance or unapproved product means no opening
Customer controls cannot be bypassed through branch/API channel
Account numbers are unique per bank and format policy
Document approval and customer agreement version immutably
Cross-institution customer IDs cannot bind to foreign accounts
planned_tests: Repeated opening request yields one account
No ledger journal from opening alone
approval_gate: Approved CIF profile, product eligibility, account agreement and bank-specific account-number policy.
